topic_zh: 用 clap 写一个命令行工具
topic_en: Build a Rust command-line tool with clap

xhs.title: Rust 命令行参数，一个结构体搞定
xhs.body:
第 19 课：用 clap 写命令行工具
cargo add clap --features derive，记得开 derive
结构体加 #[derive(Parser)]：普通字段是位置参数，#[arg(short, long)] 变成 -c / --count 选项
main 里一句 Args::parse()，--help 自动生成，类型不对直接报错
考考你：count: u8，运行 greet Ann -c 300，是打印 300 遍还是报错？ 评论区告诉我～

douyin.title: 一分钟用 Rust + clap 写个命令行工具
douyin.body:

tiktok.body: Stop parsing command-line args by hand. One struct + clap does it, --help included. Quick quiz: count is a u8 and you run greet Ann -c 300. Prints 300 times, or errors? Comment your answer.

linkedin.title: A Rust CLI in one struct
linkedin.body:
With clap's derive API, a struct with #[derive(Parser)] is your argument spec.
Plain fields are required positional arguments; #[arg(short, long)] turns a field into -c / --count.
Args::parse() fills the struct, and /// doc comments become the auto-generated --help.
The field type is the validation: a u8 field rejects "abc" with a clear error.
Quick quiz: count is a u8 and you run greet Ann -c 300. Prints 300 times, or errors? Answer in the comments.

quiz.q_zh: #[arg(short, long, default_value_t = 1)] count: u8，运行 greet Ann -c 300，打印 300 遍还是报错？
quiz.q_en: #[arg(short, long, default_value_t = 1)] count: u8. You run greet Ann -c 300. Prints 300 times, or errors?
quiz.answer_zh: 答案：报错。u8 最大只到 255，clap 解析时就拒绝了：error: invalid value '300' for '--count <COUNT>': 300 is not in 0..=255。
quiz.answer_en: Answer: an error. A u8 only goes up to 255, so clap rejects it while parsing: error: invalid value '300' for '--count <COUNT>': 300 is not in 0..=255.
